cells.gaps: No source says any chiefdom, sector or commune office is working over a connection: the Starlink kits in Haut-Uélé are reported handed over on 17 March 2026, not installed or in use, and who pays the subscription is not stated. The 45 is a count of entities given kits in one province, with no total of entities, and no plan naming the connection of local governments or budget line is on record.
cells.note: Stage 2 because the only connection evidence is kits handed to 45 chiefdoms and sectors of one province, which is preparation until a source says they are in use. Stage 3 needs an institutional connection live in some local government offices outside the capital, and none is stated.
